items.name: t-shieldbearer
items.subject: the SHIELDBEARER, the beetles' front-line tank: a rhinoceros beetle with one big black horn, black chitin head with big glossy black eyes, royal-blue and brass shoulder plates, and the top edge of its huge riveted royal-blue tower shield with a steel boss raised in front of its body on the right side of the frame.

items.name: t-hornbreaker
items.subject: the HORNBREAKER, the beetle warlord hero: a Hercules beetle whose long curved black horn sweeps up and forward, black chitin head with big eyes, a royal-blue cape and brass-trimmed royal-blue pauldrons, the head of his great steel-and-brass hammer with a violet substance-glass core resting on his shoulder.

items.name: t-war-lodge
items.subject: the WAR LODGE, the beetles' barracks: a squat riveted fortress block of dark steel and royal-blue plates with brass trim, horned corner towers, a big royal-blue shield crest over a portcullis gate.

items.name: t-arc-lash
items.subject: ARC LASH, the Coilkeeper's spell: a jagged chain of brilliant violet lightning leaps from the brass coil-tip of her lantern-staff (lower left) and forks across the frame, jumping between three dark silhouetted enemy insects. Energy colour: violet and electric blue-white.

items.name: t-horn-rush
items.subject: HORN RUSH, the Hornbreaker's charge: the hero's great curved black horn and armoured head drive forward diagonally out of the frame toward the viewer, lowered like a battering ram, with dust and orange-white speed streaks trailing behind and a burst of impact sparks at the horn's tip. Energy colour: hot orange and white.

items.name: t-plating-2
items.subject: PLATING II, a beetle armour upgrade (tier two of three): one thick curved royal-blue armour plate (a shoulder pauldron) of riveted dark steel with polished brass edging and heavy brass rivets, shown on its own as a crafted part.

items.name: t-substance
items.subject: SUBSTANCE, the forest's raw magic, one of the game's two resources: a cluster of translucent, faceted violet-blue crystal shards growing out of a small dark root knot, glowing from within with deep violet and blue light, a few drifting violet motes. Never green.

items.name: t-ant-warrior
items.subject: the ANT WARRIOR, the ants' basic melee soldier (the axe-wielding ants in the middle of the reference board): a rust-orange ant head with big black eyes, ivory mandible tusks and antennae, a mantle of deep red maple leaves on its shoulders, and the ivory bone axe blade raised beside its head.
